name: auv150
description: Digital twin of the CSIR-CMERI / IIT-Kharagpur 'AUV-150' (India's indigenous 150 m-class research AUV), as fielded with a stock ArduSub-class autopilot. Submerged multi-thruster AUV: no GPS/AIS underwater, position from an acoustic/ExternalNav feed. Boot via tools/run_vehicle.sh vehicle_twins/auv150 up.

gps_spoof.reason: N/A while submerged -- GPS RF does not penetrate water (the AUV has no GPS fix underwater)

ais_spoof.reason: N/A -- submerged AUV, no AIS transponder in the water column
